steps.name: Restaurant Owner
steps.text: Scusa, Bettina, I'd love to help you, but... I'm running a small business here too, y'know.

steps.name: Restaurant Owner
steps.text: Those bottles I got from you last time are still on my wine rack, gathering dust. Why not go ask at the corner store?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Right, I'll go do that! Grazie, Zio Paolo!

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: ...I already asked, actually. Nobody wants any.

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: I've gotta move all this out of the way first. If I keep standing around here like a fool, I'll affect Zio Paolo's business.

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Hup—Wh-Wh-Whoaaaaawha?!

steps.name: Passing Girl
steps.text: Careful!

steps.name: Passing Girl
steps.text: That was close... Here, hold it tight now.

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Th-Thank you, signorina.

steps.name: Passing Girl
steps.text: Man, this is heavy, no wonder a little kid like you couldn't carry it right. What's in this—

steps.name: Passing Girl
steps.text: Oh, it's Verdi.

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: You know it?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: I'm Bettina, and this is from the Verdi Winery where my nonno works! The winery's got decades of history behind it! Would you like to buy a bottle, signorina?

steps.name: Passing Girl
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Passing Girl
steps.text: Bettina, right? I guess it's fate I've bumped into you, so let's make friends.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: I'm Tosia. Here, my card.

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Wow, cool, a business card! Sorry, I don't have one... Huh?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Kazimierz Golden Prairie Winery, Nuova Volsinii branch... sales representative?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: I'm betting that before long, it'll say 'Senior Relationship Manager'...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: But that's the thing. I'm afraid we're competitors, so I won't be buying your wine.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Now, if you wouldn't mind scooching out of the way, little Miss Bettina, I have a great deal to make with Signor Paolo.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: You just arrived in Nuova Volsinii, and you've already talked the locals into some huge deals! Excellent work!

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Come, Tosia! Today, we give our top sales rep the welcome feast she deserves!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: You're too kind, Wujek Czarek!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: You've been busy getting the Red Wine Championship ready, so of course you didn't have time for dinner. I just hope I haven't been much trouble.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Not at all! I'm a lucky man, getting an experienced sales girl to join us at Golden Prairie!

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: But I heard you were doing well at the Krzywy Domek Department Store. Why Nuova Volsinii all of a sudden?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: It's... a long story.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Let me guess, it's something to do with that... 'Silverlance Pegasus corruption case' that's got Kawalerielki all abuzz lately?
Though Czarek lowered his voice, the mention of the case has Tosia jerking her head upwards.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: How did you...?

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: I was told that the G.C.C. sent agents to Krzywy Domek and took one of your managers a few days ago. Your old manager, even.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Guess there's no hiding anything from you. She took good care of me, but... one of her relatives is a Silverlance Pegasus.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: It was a point of pride, but once the G.C.C. started poking around... Whenever they can't directly move against the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi, they take the people around them for 'questioning'.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: And more and more people keep getting involved in the case. Some poor souls get the entire book thrown at them, even though anyone with eyes can see they're totally innocent...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: If normal folk like us get pulled into this kind of trouble, how're we supposed to resist giants like the G.C.C.?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: That's why I thought it'd be better to come here and expand—

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Tosia, Golden Prairie would not have grown this large in Nuova Volsinii without behind-the-scenes support from the G.C.C.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: When the big shots show some initiative and want to expand their horizons, that is a good thing for businesspeople like us.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: ...You're right.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Let's not think too much about Kawalerielki while we're here.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Just keep your enthusiasm flowing and do a good job. When my business is growing, it's only good for you, no?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Then I'll thank you in advance, Wujek Czarek.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Clever girl. I won't belabor the point, then.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: I've already ordered the food, just need to know what you want to drink.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Sorry for putting all that on you. Honestly, I'm not too good at handling wine.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Let me see...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Oh, right, I'm looking for a certain brown-colored soft drink. I think it's a local Siracusan brand, tastes like orange with a bit of bitterness?

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Do you mean Chinotto, signorina? I am terribly sorry, but we don't carry that one.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Where did you even learn of that old beverage? Since we put out our soft drink line, the local brands have pretty much all died out.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Huh... Really?

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Did you forget our slogan, Tosia? 'Nuova Volsinii, Vita Nuova'. Leave the retro nostalgia to the Leithanians.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: How about some zero-proof sparkling water?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Haha, sure! Let's go with that, then.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Good, good. Oh, almost forgot. Come, I wanted to show this to you.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: It's a... shelf display agreement?

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Just a draft template. I was hoping to hear what our top sales representative thought before we deployed it.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: It's very clear on the criteria, and the rewards are generous... There shouldn't be too many retailers who decline.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: But if they do accept, it means they can only display our products while the agreement is in force.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Wouldn't an exclusivity clause like that create legal issues under local law?

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: There's nothing in the New Urban Management Act that says we can't have one.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: The way I see it, those Lupos with their heads full of dreams and faith won't see any issues with it.
Czarek shrugs, a smile of victory on his face.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: But it's you frontline employees who will be talking to the retailers, not me. I'm eager to see how you do, when the time comes, Tosia.

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Thank you for waiting. Your zero-proof sparkling water, signorina.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Come, to Nuova Volsinii, and to vita nuova! Na zdrowie!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: ...I would never let you down, Wujek Czarek.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Na zdrowie!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Whew... I'm stuffed!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: 'Chef's Selection'... Seriously? Tiny portions and way too much fuss.
After shoving the last piece of pizza into her mouth, Tosia brushes the crumbs off her hands and continues her walk back to her place alongside the night breeze.
The street is lit up in vibrant colors by a chaotic mix of billboards, shining as bright as day. This nightscape is breathtaking, but it could not be more different from the Siracusa Tosia imagined.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: ...Shelf display agreement, more like shelf monopoly agreement.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: It's going to get a whole lot of people fired, maybe even bankrupted, won't it? Like that kid from before. Once the agreement's signed, she won't be able to sell her wine, no matter how much legwork she puts in...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: But it's got to be done. Those Victorians and Columbians aren't going to let an opportunity this big slip by, even if we did.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Oh? It's you, the lady from this morning.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: How's it going? Manage to sell any...?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: *sigh* You're still carrying the same bottles, aren't you?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: You're a really good saleswoman, right, Signorina Tosia? Can you—

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Huh? But I didn't even get to ask...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: You want me to teach you a trick or two, right? I can read it on your face. Anyway, no can do, no way.

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: But why?
The despondency and incomprehension on the girl's face force a long sigh out of Tosia.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: How old are you, Bettina?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: I'm ten next week.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Ten, huh... Alright, let me put this in a way you can understand.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Listen, I know having to make a living at your age isn't easy. If things were different, I wouldn't mind helping you out.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: I only got to where I am today thanks to the help of others. A favor is an investment, not a cost.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: But here's the problem: there's only so much wine one Nuova Volsinian can drink in a day.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: You're selling Verdi, I'm selling Golden Prairie. We're business rivals, enemies even.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Of course, in a situation like this, some people would drop any cost-benefit analysis, and choose to help a helpless little kid like you... but that's not me.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Because I'm a woman with a heart of stone!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: The business world is a battlefield! Helping your enemy is just stabbing yourself in the back!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: I've set my mind on flying up the ranks and living the good life, and I'm not going to go soft on my foe just because she's a kid! You got that?!

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Got it...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Good! I'm off, then. You keep at it.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: ...Was I too harsh on her?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Can't blame me for it. That black-hearted uncle of mine is obviously trying to use pie-in-the-sky promises to trick me into doing his dirty work.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: If I want to find my footing here, I don't have time to get involved in other people's business.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: But... she's not crying, is she? Let's just turn around and get a quick look, just one look...

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: (Droops head, as if grieving)

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: (Grabs hold of bridge railing)

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: (Stands on top of railing)

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: (As if about to jump—)

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Whoa, whoa, WHOA! WAIT, WAIT! DON'T JUST THROW YOUR LIFE AWAY LIKE THAT—!

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Wha—?!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Made it... Good thing I got quick reflexes...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Kids these days have no mental fortitude! I'll teach you, okay?!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Seriously, even when my performance was in the gutter, and I was homeless and living under a bridge, eating thrown-out fries, things weren't that bad!

spans.text: Seriously, even when my performance was in the gutter, and I was homeless and living under a bridge, eating thrown-out fries, things weren't

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: You're young, you've got plenty of time ahead of you! As long as you're alive, there's hope! Even if things are hard now, you need to believe things will get bet...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: ter...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Why are you looking at me like that?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: I think you misunderstood something, Signorina Tosia. I was trying to save Pane.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: ...Pane?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Over there, on the other side of the railing. It's so naughty, wandering off like that...

steps.name: Pane
steps.text: Woof!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: So you weren't trying to...?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Haha, thank goodness. I guess I looked real stupid trying to calm you down just now, worried as I was.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: But even if you were trying to save it, you didn't need to go over the railing, you know! That's dangerous!

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: But my arms aren't long enough...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Alright, fine, out of the way! You better not bite me, Pane!

steps.name: Well-Dressed Woman
steps.text: Sono molto grata, Bettina! If you hadn't brought my bambino back to me, why, I don't know what to do!

spans.text: , Bettina! If you hadn't brought my bambino back to me, why, I don't know what to do!

steps.name: Well-Dressed Woman
steps.text: We'll head back home now. Say ciao to Bettina, Pane.

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Okay! Ciao, Signora Bianca! Ciao, Pane!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Huh? Wait, aren't you going to ask her?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Ask her what?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: About the wine! I feel like getting sales through personal connections is rather high-cost-low-efficiency, but any port in a storm. Definitely beats starving.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Didn't you help her find Pane so she would buy your wine?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Don't tell me you did it out of the goodness of your heart.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Am I misunderstanding something? Is your family not in big trouble? Does it not matter if this stuff sells?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: No, of course it matters! I just want to help sell the wine. Nonno says sales have been getting worse and worse lately, and if we can't make enough this month, the winery will have to close...

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: What should I do? You said you'd teach me.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: What? When did I say that—

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Kids these days have no mental fortitude! I'll teach you, okay?!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Oh. I guess I did. Though I thought you were going to... Ahem.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: I'm not trying to wiggle out of what I said, but take a good look at your product. Cheap, local wines like your Verdi are the worst performers in the current market.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Outdated production facilities, careless cost control, old-fashioned marketing... While Golden Prairie offers some better-quality budget wines, and they are only half the price. Only a fool would pick the other option.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: The winery your nonno works for is doomed. My advice to him is to start looking for a new job sooner rather than later.

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: But the adults all say there's no such thing as an unsellable product, only salespeople who can't sell it.

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: I know Verdi is hard to sell... Is it so bad that not even you could sell it, Signorina Tosia?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: First you trick me into giving you advice, then you go for a psychological tactic? You've got moves.

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Trick...?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: But I won't fall for it, hehe.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: I don't have to get mixed up in your problems to prove myself. I'm last year's sales star at the Krzywy Domek Department Store, and the future top salesperson at Golden Prairie. There's nothing I can't sell...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: That's right, absolutely nothing! Alright, since you've talked your way this far, allow me to teach you a thing or two!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: With my secret sales techniques, forget selling a few bottles, you'll be selling crates by the dozen!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: ...Alright, tell me the story. Why is it you haven't sold a single bottle yet?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Sorry, I know how hard it was for you to find free time to teach me, but I... *sniff*

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: I can afford a day off, I've built enough of a lead on second place. Gotta leave myself some room for improvement next month...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: The important thing is, you're my apprentice, how can you be getting stuck like this?! Are you really doing things the way I taught you?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: I did my best to use the words you taught me, but...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: But?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Things like 'the wine is full-bodied, with exquisite balance and a lively zing'. I don't understand what they mean at all, so how am I supposed to pretend I do when talking to people?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: And then saying things like our wine 'comes from a winery with deep historical roots'... We just use grapes from our own vineyard. Isn't this misleading?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Nonno says we should put ourselves in other people's shoes, and be sincere when dealing with them. That way, everyone will trust us. It's the only way to get a good deal that everyone's happy with, so I... I...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: *sigh*... I knew it.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Listen to me. Your playbook is outdated.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: You're being sincere, but other people aren't necessarily going to be sincere back. Gullible idiots get swindled and lose everything. Even if they put it all on the line to make some cash, they just burn themselves out.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: You'll see, when you find yourself in a desperate situation. Then you'll look around and see no one ready to lend you a hand. Sincerity means nothing in the face of profit.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: You can't entrust your survival to anyone else. We need to be smart, or we'll get gobbled up. You hear me?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: I... I don't know...
The sight of the girl with her head lowered, clutching at her clothes, makes Tosia decide to lighten up a bit.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Look, I'm not saying you need to become a swindler yourself. You just need to package it a little nicer, that's all.

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Package it?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Yep, like using a ribbon to tie a pretty bow, and putting it in a nice bag...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: There we go! Looks much more presentable than before.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: You might've already noticed, but there's a huge change coming to the wine racks of Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Used to be that they'd only stock a few types of wine. But now, you can easily find Pinot noirs from Victoria, Cabernet Sauvignons from Columbia, sweet rosés from Bolívar...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: It's a miracle for sure, but can you see where the issue lies when you lift up your glass?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: This miracle was born from stringent production criteria, and carried all across Terra in cargo containers. They're appropriately priced, and are stable in quality, but what they lack is soul.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Wine isn't meant to lack personality like a fast-food burger! Put those dime-a-dozen industrial goods back on the shelf, and look at the premium gold label Sangiovese in my hand!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: The product of craftsmanship honed over decades at a local Siracusan winery! A unique flavor with a lingering aftertaste! One sip will delight the mind, two sips will bring good health—

steps.name: Travel-Stained Man
steps.text: I'd like one. Will this be enough?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Wha?

steps.name: Travel-Stained Man
steps.text: Aren't you two selling wine? I'm pressed for time, so give it here quick. Err... How do I look?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Ah, er, you look perfectly fine... Where's the fire, signor?

steps.name: Travel-Stained Man
steps.text: I find myself needing to meet someone, but it's rather last-minute. I didn't expect them to be in Nuova Volsinii, and in my rush, I wasn't able to prepare a gift. Lucky I ran into you.

steps.name: Travel-Stained Man
steps.text: Grazie mille, signorine. I hope your business goes well.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Signor, wait—Damn, he's fast.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Err... I was only trying to give you an example. Didn't expect there to be anyone crazy enough to actually buy it. Probably a foreigner, since he didn't recognize the wine?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: He gave us enough to buy a ton of Verdi...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: This is great, though! We finally sold our first bottle! How about a high-five?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: But... Mm...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Why the long face? Selling something is a victory, even if it was a misunderstanding. It's his own fault for not studying up...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: But he did look like he was really in a rush. Must be a really important meeting?

spans.text: But he did look like he was
in a rush. Must be a really important meeting?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Hey, kid... If you show up with a bottle of cheap wine in Siracusa... What happens?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: —So that's why we're really sorry!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Here's your money back. Please, use it for some other gift. This isn't a high-quality wine, it's just a bottle of—

steps.name: Travel-Stained Man
steps.text: Verdi, right? So that's why you two were chasing after me in a panic.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: You know it?

steps.name: Travel-Stained Man
steps.text: How could I not, considering all the years I've drank? I was born in Sorrento, and many years ago, I had a falling out with my family. In my anger, I ran off to Columbia.

steps.name: Travel-Stained Man
steps.text: You can laugh if you want. My Siracusan is a little rusty these days.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: But if you knew, then why did you...?

steps.name: Travel-Stained Man
steps.text: Haha! If I brought a fancy foreign wine as a gift, I'm afraid my papà would slam the door in my face.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: The meeting is with your own family?

steps.name: Travel-Stained Man
steps.text: I didn't know they moved here. I saw them while I was out on the street, nearly didn't recognize them.

steps.name: Travel-Stained Man
steps.text: What once felt like the biggest deal in all of Siracusa now barely feels important at all. All these years, I had no contact at all. It's time I finally dropped by.

steps.name: Travel-Stained Man
steps.text: My family was not well-off, so we had Verdi with dinner. I don't know why Papà never tired of it... I hope that once he sees this bottle, he'll let me in.

steps.name: Travel-Stained Man
steps.text: So there's been no misunderstanding here. A bottle of common, ordinary Verdi, wrapped with care, appeared in front of me precisely when I needed it. And for that, I am willing to pay this price.

steps.name: Travel-Stained Man
steps.text: If it still weighs on your conscience, then why not offer me a 'good luck' as a bonus?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: ...Sure! Best of luck to you!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Never thought I'd see the day I'd chase down a buyer to get my product back... You're looking chipper. Happy now?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Mhm! When I tell Nonno, he's gonna say I made a good deal.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Then how about a high-five?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Yay!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: No time to rest on your laurels, though. We've only sold one bottle. You can't count on more happy accidents—

steps.name: Foreign Young Man
steps.text: Excuse me, are you Bettina?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: I am. Who might you be, signore?

steps.name: Foreign Young Man
steps.text: Finally found you. Miss Bianca says you sell traditional Siracusan red wine. Is that right?

steps.name: Foreign Young Man
steps.text: I'm planning to open a Siracusan restaurant in Victoria, and I might consider bringing a few such items back with me. Could you introduce your product?

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Oh, you mean...?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: A golden opportunity is knocking, Bettina! Don't just stand there, the important part is putting your marketing skills to good use next! Still remember what I taught you—

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Bettina
steps.text: Signorina Tosia?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Never mind, kid. You... You graduated.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Just forget everything I said. It's better you do things your own way.
Tosia watches the girl and the young man move to the curb, listing out the gains and losses in her head out of habit.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: A Siracusan restaurant... Even if he's looking for a local wine, he'd make more profit if he went for something a couple grades higher than Verdi. Well, it's all about what the buyer thinks, in the end.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Just gotta hope he signs a long-term agreement. Though, even if he does, it's still a drop in the bucket. This label isn't going to escape bankruptcy or acquisition that easily...

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Hmm?
The conversation nearby seems to pause for a moment. The girl turns to Tosia, jumping and waving her hands, a bright smile plastered all over her face.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Looks like things are going well.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Whatever... As long as she's happy.
One week later.

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: I've spoken with Mr. Roger, and he approves of your idea. He simply has some hesitation about getting involved, and is worried about the risks.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: No rush, the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi isn't making any big moves right now, but this doesn't mean things will go the way G.C.C. planned.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: We may be backed by the G.C.C. right now... but we need to make our own preparations.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: No matter which of these titans lets something slip through its fingers, we shall enjoy a sumptuous feast.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: We are not the only ones waiting to get a slice of the pie. We simply need to be ready, and wait for the perfect wave to carry us aloft...

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Ohoho, look who it is! Our shining star of the market finally arrives.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Sales tells me you got quite a few local retailers to sign our shelf display agreement, so I thought we should celebrate!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Thanks. It was just like you said, not much resistance when we were talking.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: I meant to have this celebratory dinner yesterday, but my secretary told me you were busy with something?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: I made friends with a local girl these past few days. She invited me to her home for dinner. Sorry, I know you don't splurge often...

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Why apologize? This is great. We're foreigners in Nuova Volsinii. Only by understanding the Siracusans can we empty their pockets.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: It seems my lovely niece has some tricks up her sleeve. You always know exactly why you do things. That's what I like the most about you.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Come, na zdrowie!

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: I think you've misunderstood something, Wujek Czarek. I didn't go to the kid's place to fish for some information. It was just to sing her 'Happy Birthday'.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: Oh, is that so?
The glass filled with first-rate red wine freezes in midair, while the young lady on the other side of the table gives him a smile.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Her family's as ordinary as can be. They even brought all their furniture in from the countryside. A family that's the complete opposite to our 'Nuova Volsinii, Vita Nuova'.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: I did manage to get one piece of good news there, though. Look.
Tosia pulls out a soft drink in a glass bottle, resting it on the pure white satin tablecloth. Czarek cannot help but laugh.

steps.name: Czarek
steps.text: You're here to eat dinner, you know. Why bring your own drink?

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: This is the Chinotto I asked about last week. Her family says there are still grocers in the city who sell it.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: I'm not sure if you remember, but my tata often went to Siracusa for work. Every time he came back, he'd bring some snacks and toys for me.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: My favorite was this drink, and I'd always beg him to bring more back next time. Haha, it would've been way too heavy, now that I think about it.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Well, you know what happened next. He lost his job, so I didn't get to drink Chinotto anymore, naturally.
Tosia pries off the cap, the soft drink in the brown glass bottle letting out a cheerful hiss.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: I've always wanted to try it again. I'm starting to think that if these 'old-fashioned things' really did disappear, it would be a real shame.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Na zdrowie, Wujek Czarek.
Tosia lifts up the bottle, knocking it against the wine glass.

steps.name: Tosia
steps.text: Honestly, that zero-proof sparkling water from last week? Not my cup of tea. No offense.
